messages:
Alex: quick notes from this morning's microbench — I ran an arch-aware kernel switch + kvpage blocksize sweep for GQA/MQA. Spoiler: page-aware kernels help for seqlen > ~512 on Hopper, but we see regressions on Ampere for some small-batch configs. cc @Marta
Alex: results (condensed):
```
model: mix-gqa-6B, MQA=on
hw: Hopper (H100) vs Ampere (A100)
batches: 1,4
kv_blocksz: 32,64,128
seqlen: 128,512,1024

H100 b=1 seqlen=512 blk=64: p50=28.2ms p99=48.1ms
H100 b=1 seqlen=1024 blk=64: p50=55.3ms p99=92.4ms
A100 b=1 seqlen=512 blk=64: p50=33.9ms p99=71.2ms
A100 b=4 seqlen=512 blk=32: p50=40.7ms p99=95.0ms
A100 b=1 seqlen=256 blk=128: p50=21.7ms (regressed +12% vs legacy)
```
Alex: notes: the page-aware kernel reduces KV memcpy and avoids some prefaults on H100; on A100 the mem-access pattern plus smaller L2 made the page-aware kernel less efficient for small batches. Also saw KV fragmentation spikes when blocksz=32.
Marta: nice quick pass. did you enable MQA path in the selector or force MQA binary? any kv cache fragmentation metrics? :eyes:
Alex: MQA was enabled via selector flag. fragmentation shows up in kv_page_reclaims and kv_frag_pct dashboards — sample log snippet: 
```
[kvcache] pages_total=8192 pages_free=210 kv_frag_pct=25.3% reclaim_ops=142
[allocator] page_reclaim_ms=12.6 heavy_reclaim=1
```
Cheng: is the autotuner choosing different kernels by arch tag today? I thought we used a single scoring table across GPUs.
Alex: autotuner currently keys on (arch_tag, seqlen_bucket, batch_bucket). we recently forgot to include kv_page_layout as a dimension — that's why the selector picked page-aware kernels everywhere once rollout flipped. fixed locally to add layout tag.
Sam: can we add hysteresis around the seqlen boundary (e.g. 400-600) to avoid flip-flop when traffic sits near 512? also maybe prefer conservative pick for Ampere.
Alex: yup planning to add a hysteresis window + prefer legacy kernel on Ampere by default until we tune. will also add kv_frag_pct to rollout gating so we don't pick page-aware when fragmentation high.
perf-bot: perf-bot: CI microbench detected a regression on A100: seqlen=256 blk=128 p50 +12% (run 2026-03-18T09:12Z) link: https://ci.internal/runs/15321 :warning:
Marta: ok prioritize ampere fix. Alex, can you open a minimal repro and create an eng-runtime ticket? @Sam can you look at scheduling and the selector toggle?
Sam: on it. I'll add a feature-flag to force legacy kernel per-arch and patch the selector to include kv_layout in the key. will also add a quick smoke CI for a few ampere+seqlen combos.
Alex: thanks. I'll attach KV page histograms and perf traces to the ticket. will also push a tiny autotuner tweak to prefer lower memory-footprint kernels on Ampere for now. :thumbsup:
Marta: sounds good. If we gate rollout on kv_frag_pct + p50 delta we should be safe. let's sync in the standup if anything blocks.
